suppress.notes: Jetty 9.4 is shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime, which is only needed for the Hadoop Configuration and compression classes parquet-java uses to read local Parquet files. No Hadoop HTTP client, server or WebHDFS code runs, so Jetty's HttpURI parsing (CVE-2024-6763) is unreachable.

Jackson 2.18.6, Commons Configuration 2.10.1 and JLine 3.9.0 are shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime 3.5.0, the latest Hadoop release. Parquet files are read with LocalInputFile and PlainParquetConfiguration, so no Hadoop JSON, YAML configuration or shell code runs. The application's own Jackson is managed separately and is not affected: it is on a different version, so these version-pinned matches only cover the shaded copies.
False positive: hadoop-shaded-protobuf_3_25 1.5.0 is Hadoop's relocated protobuf, not Apache Hadoop 1.5.0.
False positive: CVE-2023-36415 was fixed in azure-identity 1.10.2 and CVE-2024-35255 in azure-identity 1.12.2 and msal4j 1.15.1. The CPE match ignores the fixed versions.
